title: Will warp FAST
text: Will warp FAST. I’m so disappointed. We have a storm door so I hung this between our front door and glass storm door. It warped badly after the first week! I wish I had paid better attention to the warning about warping. Other than that, it’s so pretty. Any ideas how to “ un-warp” this?

product_metadata.title: Studio M Door Decor Showers of Flowers Decorative Front Door Sign with Handmade Hanger, Durable Fade Resistant PVC, Made in the USA, 13.25"w x 20.25"h
features: BETTER ART: Studio M works with top artists to bring you beautiful, unique designs.
RICHER COLOR: Door Décor is digitally printed in the USA with vivid, fade-resistant outdoor inks for rich, long-lasting color.
DURABLE DESIGN: Door Décor is made from durable, lightweight PVC and features a coordinating, hand-tied bow for easy hanging.
MADE IN THE USA: Studio M Door Décor is proudly made in St. Louis, Missouri.
This Door Décor is part of a specially designed collection – complete the look with coordinating products from Studio M like BreezeArt flags, MatMates, Yard DeSigns, and MailWraps.
description: Add a touch of artful personality to your home each season with Studio M Door Decor! Digitally printed on durable PVC, each Door Decor features vivid colors and a hand-tied hanger – some styles feature a handmade bow, while others hang from rustic jute or rope. Welcome your guests with vivid, beautiful Door Decor from Studio M. Please Note: Exposure to excessive heat in a confined space may cause warping. Door Decor is created by the team of passionate people at Studio M, a family-owned provider of nature-inspired home and garden decor located in St. Louis, Missouri. Owners Curt and Sue Todd started the company 30 years ago when they invented the first magnetic mailbox cover, MailWraps. What started as a home-based business with one product to sell has expanded into a community of over 75 employees, hundreds of artists and independent retailers, and thousands of remarkable products. At Studio M, we strive to make products that are artful, innovative, and that we are proud to stand behind.
